managed_device.title: Managed device configuration
managed_device.description: Configure the load and its constraints. Casa ES uses these values in dry-run and stores them for future real-control features. Priority: 1 = highest, 10 = lowest.

data.name: Device name
data.min_battery_soc: Minimum battery SOC to allow the device (%)
data.max_grid_power_w: Maximum grid power for this device (W, 0 = no per-device limit)
data.requires_entity: Requires another device to be active (optional)
data.on_only: On-only: do not automatically turn off after start
data.protect_preemption: Protect from preemption by higher-priority loads
data.battery_discharge_override_w: Battery discharge limit while active (W, 0 = none)
data.enabled: Enable this device in Casa ES management

data_description.name: Use a recognizable name, for example Boiler, Dehumidifier, Living room AC or Dishwasher.
data_description.entity_id: Select the entity Casa ES may control in the future, such as switch.boiler, climate.living_room or water_heater.boiler. In dry-run it is only read and simulated.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional but recommended. Select a sensor measuring only this appliance in W, kW or MW.
data_description.nominal_power_w: Enter the typical electrical draw while active. Casa ES uses it to test PV, inverter, phase and energy-budget headroom.
data_description.priority: Number from 1 to 10. Lower numbers are evaluated first when power or energy is scarce.
data_description.phase: Select the physical phase: L1, L2, L3, or Three-phase for a real three-phase load.
data_description.expected_runtime_minutes: Typical duration of one run. Used to reserve the expected kWh from the flexible-energy budget.
data_description.min_battery_soc: Below this battery percentage the device is not considered admissible.
data_description.allow_grid: When disabled, a new start needs sufficient PV. When enabled, grid power may supplement PV within the configured limits.
data_description.max_grid_power_w: Per-device grid supplementation limit. Zero means no additional per-device limit beyond Casa ES global limits.
data_description.min_daily_runtime_minutes: Minimum daily runtime target. Stored now and used as a hard planner constraint once real scheduling is enabled.
data_description.max_daily_runtime_minutes: Maximum total runtime per day. Must be greater than or equal to the minimum runtime.
data_description.max_daily_activations: Maximum starts per day. Use zero for unlimited.
data_description.schedule_deadline: Time by which the minimum daily runtime should be completed.
data_description.start_after: Earliest allowed start time. Leave empty for no limit.
data_description.end_before: Latest allowed running time. Can be combined with Start after, including windows that cross midnight.
data_description.requires_entity: If set, this load may start only while the selected entity is active.
data_description.switch_interval_seconds: Minimum time between state changes, useful for compressors and HVAC equipment.
data_description.averaging_window_seconds: Per-device smoothing window for available power. Zero means use the manager default.
data_description.on_only: For cycles that should not be interrupted after Casa ES starts them, such as washing machines or dishwashers.
data_description.protect_preemption: Prevents this load from being shed only to make room for a higher-priority load once real control is enabled.
data_description.big_consumer: Marks high-demand loads so battery protection can be more conservative while they run.
data_description.battery_discharge_override_w: Desired maximum battery discharge while this load runs. Zero means no device-specific limit.
data_description.dynamic_current: For wallboxes or other variable-current loads. Casa ES will be able to modulate amps instead of only switching on/off.
data_description.current_entity: When dynamic current is enabled, select the number.* entity that sets charging current.
data_description.min_current_a: Minimum current accepted by the device.
data_description.max_current_a: Maximum current Casa ES may request.
data_description.ev_soc_sensor: Vehicle battery percentage sensor. Leave empty for non-EV loads.
data_description.ev_connected_sensor: Binary sensor indicating whether the vehicle is connected.
data_description.ev_target_soc: Vehicle SOC above which charging should stop when EV management is enabled.
data_description.enabled: Turn this off to keep the device configured but exclude it from Casa ES decisions.
